name: Blok Orchard
description: Blok Orchard is a family-run farm in Ada, MI. It grows Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, Apples, and Peaches, with seasonal availability through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
